Clinton County Port Authority
The Clinton County Port Authority is a special purpose government formed to operate transportation
infrastructure and lead economic development efforts. The Port Authority coordinates partnerships to attract and retain jobs and investment county-wide. It owns and operates the Wilmington Air Park, an integrated aviation and logistics business park with 1,900 acres and nearly three million square feet of industrial, office and hangar space.

Veterans Service Commission
The mission of the Clinton County Veterans’ Service Office Commission is to provide service to our nations honorably discharged veterans by assisting them in gaining access to federal and local entitlement programs managed by the DVA (Department of Veteran’s Affairs) and the VSC (Veterans’ Service Commission). We will at no cost to the veteran, assist him/her and or their dependent parents, spouses or children in the preparation and management of claims for benefits to which they may be legally entitled.
